task: Two new git doc sources were just added to this repo - `souin` (darkweak/souin, sparse path docs/website/content, rootPath docs/website/content) and `caddy-cache-handler` (caddyserver/cache-handler, whole-repo walk) in src/application/sources.ts, both tagged ["networking", "caching"] in src/application/source-tags.ts with a new `caching` label in TAG_LABELS. src/commands/build-index.ts was also extended to recognise TOML (`+++`-delimited) frontmatter in addition to YAML (`---`), so Hugo TOML pages like souin's get proper index titles. The full verification battery must pass. If any sensor fails, fix the underlying source code or test - NEVER weaken, delete, or skip a test, NEVER loosen a sensor, and NEVER touch git refs (no commit/reset/stash). CI parity matters: the `tools-sync` sensor mirrors the CI 'Verify tools.sh is in sync' step - if it fails, run `pnpm generate:tools` and keep commands/tools.sh committed in sync with src/commands/tools-template.ts. The fetch-verify sensor does a real network fetch of the two new sources (DOCS_ONLY=souin,caddy-cache-handler) into /tmp and asserts the pages land and index with correct TOML-derived titles - if it fails, check the sparse paths/rootPath on the DocSource entries and the TOML handling in build-index.ts.

sensors.name: lint
sensors.hint: tsc --noEmit type errors - fix the TypeScript, do not suppress.

sensors.name: tools-sync
sensors.hint: commands/tools.sh is auto-generated from src/commands/tools-template.ts. Run `pnpm generate:tools` and commit the regenerated file - never edit tools.sh directly.

sensors.name: unit
sensors.hint: Vitest unit failures - read the failing assertion, fix the source, never the test's expectations (unless the test itself encodes the old wrong behaviour AND the task says behaviour changed).

sensors.name: sources-present
sensors.cmd: rg -q 'name: "souin"' src/application/sources.ts && rg -q 'name: "caddy-cache-handler"' src/application/sources.ts && rg -q 'souin:' src/application/source-tags.ts && rg -q '"caddy-cache-handler":' src/application/source-tags.ts && rg -q 'caching:' src/application/source-tags.ts
sensors.hint: The two new DocSource entries and their SOURCE_TAGS + TAG_LABELS wiring must exist. Restore them if a previous iteration clobbered them.

sensors.name: fetch-verify
sensors.cmd: rm -rf /tmp/loop-docs-verify && DOCS_ONLY=souin,caddy-cache-handler DOCS_OUT_DIR=/tmp/loop-docs-verify DOCS_MAX_AGE=0 pnpm fetch-docs >/dev/null 2>&1 && test "$(find /tmp/loop-docs-verify/souin -name '*.md' | wc -l)" -ge 36 && test -f /tmp/loop-docs-verify/caddy-cache-handler/README.md && node --import tsx/esm src/commands/build-index.ts /tmp/loop-docs-verify | awk -F'\t' '$1=="souin/docs/middlewares/caddy.md" && $2=="Caddy" {found=1} END{exit !found}' && node --import tsx/esm src/commands/build-index.ts /tmp/loop-docs-verify | awk -F'\t' '$1=="souin/docs/configuration.md" && $2=="Configuration" {found=1} END{exit !found}' && jq -e '.caching.sources | contains(["souin","caddy-cache-handler"])' /tmp/loop-docs-verify/_source_groups.json >/dev/null
sensors.hint: End-to-end: real git fetch of both new sources, >=36 souin markdown files, cache-handler README present, TOML frontmatter yields correct index titles (souin/docs/middlewares/caddy.md -> 'Caddy'), and the caching group contains both sources. Failures usually mean wrong sparse paths/rootPath on the DocSource, or broken TOML parsing in build-index.ts.

sensors.name: e2e
sensors.hint: Docker-based E2E (3-min timeout). It wipes ./docs at setup AND teardown - that is expected. Read the failing vitest output; if the Docker build itself fails, check the Dockerfile stages. Do not skip the test to make it green.
